label: ercot53 hsl 930fill
definition: ercot53 HSL known-bad-window 930 fill (KEEPER-TRACK CANDIDATE; single measured-input fix on the ercot52 config, zero config deltas -- coal net-summer derate + ORDC cap-dual adder ON, offer curves untouched): the 2024 HSL parquet's cited known-bad NP6 window (2024-08-20..23) was nulled then linearly interpolated, and with night-bounded endpoints that zeroed 4 days of August solar potential (~810 GWh) and bridged wind flat -- 17 of ercot52's 37 2024 tail hours and most of the Aug-2024 like-for-like monthly error (+62.6%) were phantom scarcity from the hole. build_ercot_hsl.py now fills cited known-bad windows from the measured EIA-930 ERCO hourly series (HSL=GEN inside the window, no fabricated curtailment headroom); the rebuilt parquet is byte-identical outside the window. 2023/2025 inputs untouched, solves reproduce ercot52 (v2.4: C3a -1.0%/-3.6%, C3b 0.109/0.079, C3c 162/5 h). 2024 on rubric v2.4: C3a -0.3% -> -6.8% (still PASS; removing the phantom scarcity reveals the underlying body-under -- the known online-capability wedge), C3b 0.296 -> 0.180, C3c 37 -> 24 h (DA actual 68), Aug demand-weighted 66.15 -> 43.38 vs perfect-model 40.68 (+62.6% -> +6.6%).
